title: The thirsty crow
blurb: On a hot summer day a crow finds a pot with too little water, and has a clever idea.

sentences.en: It was a hot summer day.
He flew here and there looking for water.
But he found no water anywhere.
At last he saw a water pot.
There was a little water in the pot.
But the water was very low.

sentences.gu: કાગડાની ચાંચ પાણી સુધી ન પહોંચી.
sentences.tr: kaagDaanee chaanch paaNee sudhee na pahonchee.
sentences.en: The crow's beak did not reach the water.

sentences.gu: ઘડા પાસે તેણે નાના કાંકરા જોયા.
sentences.tr: ghaDaa paase teNe naanaa kaankraa joyaa.
sentences.en: Near the pot he saw some small pebbles.

sentences.gu: તેણે એક કાંકરો ચાંચમાં લઈને ઘડામાં નાખ્યો.
sentences.tr: teNe ek kaankro chaanchmaan laine ghaDaamaan naakhyo.
sentences.en: He picked up a pebble in his beak and dropped it into the pot.

sentences.gu: તેણે એક પછી એક ઘણા કાંકરા નાખ્યા.
sentences.tr: teNe ek pachhee ek ghaNaa kaankraa naakhyaa.
sentences.en: One by one, he dropped in many pebbles.

sentences.gu: તરસ્યા કાગડાએ પેટ ભરીને પાણી પીધું.
sentences.tr: tarasyaa kaagDaae peT bhareene paaNee peedhun.
sentences.en: The thirsty crow drank all the water he wanted.

sentences.gu: પછી તે ખુશ થઈને ઊડી ગયો.
sentences.tr: pachhee te khush thaine ooDee gayo.

sentences.gu: મહેનત અને બુદ્ધિથી બધું શક્ય છે.
sentences.tr: mahenat ane buddhithee badhun shakya chhe.
sentences.en: With hard work and cleverness, anything is possible.
